native_validity_transitions.definition: Failed means no native valid solid in a terminal record, including missing/error/timeout; pending is unknown.

protocol.timeout_scope: whole subprocess from launch, including native/compat validity and geometry metrics

sampling.face_distribution: triangle-area-weighted within each face; equal count per face
sampling.edge_distribution: uniform native curve parameter including endpoints
sampling.degenerate_edges: repeat a real topological vertex; never use an origin fallback
sampling.coordinates: as stored; no alignment, scaling or rotation
sampling.cd: mean(pred-to-gt squared nearest distance) + mean(gt-to-pred squared nearest distance)

protocol.native_validity: read.precision.mode=0; as-read TopAbs_SOLID and BRepCheck before mutation
protocol.compatibility_validity: fresh read mode=1, precision=.1; SetTolerance(.1); TopAbs_SOLID and BRepCheck
